pages.text: --- Page 1 --- JAR LAKA BHAH Da I Kong Minimon Laloo Ba la thoh kyrpang na ka bynta Jong ki Briew badon jingduna haki Dkhot Met Jongki (Dedicated to Disabled Persons) La pynmh da :- I Bah E. Shabong Umsohsun, Shillong·1 --- Page 3 --- JAR LAKA BHAH I Kong Minimon Laloo 1992 Iaka Hok Tynrai La Tyngkai La pynmih da I Bah Emoolang Shabong La mana ban aiwal lakane ka Kot.
Lada lap ia kino kino ki ba leh pyrshah Yn Pynshitom iaki kat kum ka ain.
State Cinttot i'braiy Gorernment of Meghalayi Shillong.
--- Page 5 --- SHI KYNTIEN NA KA NONGTHOH Ia kane ka kot nga la thoh kyrpang tang shaphang kito ki bapli ki briew kibadon Jing duna ha ki dkhot Jongki.

Nga da kyimen baki Nongpule baieit kin don ka jing sngewlem ia kum kine ki biiew. Ia ka kyrteng jong kine ki khynnah, la shu pynwan- dui de ban pynsngew tynnad hakane ka siin khana, ryngkat bad ki khynnah ba anna shisha Sa shisien pat, nga, al khublel la phi ki Nongpule Baieit jong nga, kiba, la al, mynsiem ia nga na, kawei ka por sha kawei pat, lyngba ki bor pule jongki.
Khublel shibun Shillong - 1 DatedUmsohsun Kong Minimon Laloo.
The 2nd October 1992.
--- Page 7 --- LYNNONG--1 JAr LAKa Bhah' Kong Minimon Laloo.
Ki khynnah ki la rkhie sngewbha naba ki da sngew- tynnad palat ka Jingialehkal iabeh lahai jong ki. Wat rkhie lapler ba ki 1 thamula.
Katba ialadepat kim lah ban,la mareh kum kita kiwel pat kikhynnah namar pisa mynsiem_ynda haba ki peit la la ki diengkyrshan bad ki shuki kali ba ki shong, naba ki long kiba dkoh.
"Ah, sangsot ia ngi" la ong, ka Maria, "Jin ba ngi la ioh lalehkai' lang, bad, ki jong ka Mineite, Lucy, Linda, Bahun""‘ Haoid kein Maria" la ong sa ka Shant.
"Ma ngi te ba sniewbok shibun, ,ym lah, ruh ban laid bha" ka da peit artad la la ki diengkyrshan.
dang 1ohi ki khmat, ban kito niuler kiba pli kiba matlah Philida. Baroh kumta ki la la rkhie lang noh la la ka kita ki nongialehkal.
Katba, ki nong, lalehkai, pat, k ia, Sngew tha- mula, ialade namar ba kim da lohsngew bha wat lada ki, biang, ki kjat ruh, ki duna pat ,ka Jingiohsngew, ki skhor.
Kumta ynda haka ki iahal kim da iohsngewbha la ki lah kut ne ki shu leh thok.
Ka Padma ka la ong "Ei Chacha pha shu leh thok ne, ngam da"iohsngew ba pha la kut ne 'pham pat --- Page 8 --- "Ha ha kut".

ha”larkhie sahuhka Chacha, "Kumno phan ioh sngew haba uto u jingdeng skhor ba pha kieng u lah hap" ka da kdew artad sha uta u tiardeng skhor Shahe (Earphone) rkhie sa ka Tulsima nga le iohsngew kein namar ma ngapyn- donkam une phone skhor, pha pat bad bym 1ohsngew bad ka pollait noh uto u phone". K1 rkhie lang noh hangta baroh.
Ha kata ka jaka ne lingsah don shibun ki khyn- jong ki.

Ym tang kiba dkoh (Lame), bad ka kyllut (Deaf), hynrei don bun kiwei kiwei pat ki jait de, kum ki bym lah bha ban, iaid (Spastic)., Don pat, kiba da don bunki jingduna ha ki la kum kiba bie) (Mentally Retarded bad Hyper-active).
Don ruh kiba thlun kibym da lait kren bha (mute) Donruhkibymnangkien (Dumb).
Hangta ha ungsah jong ki,,don khleh shibun k? jait bynriew kum ki Bengalee, Sikkimese, Assamese, Garo.
Mizo.Khasi.
Jaintia,Nepali, kt War, ki Bhoi de.
Ba- ralok, kim ju don kano kano ka Jingiathud ne jing ia kynat bad ki bym dei ki para, doh para , snam lajong.
Teng teng pat ki ju a.
sngewdom naha kim la sngew. khynnah khasi pat ki phaluh phung phang da ka ktien bind1 ba ju la kren ha cw ha hat.
Shu lapei hi tangba teng teng pat ki shu hap ban iakdew ne pyni haba kim Sngew nang akren.
Ki, nongpyniaid ong kane ka skul bad ingshong katno ki sngewphuhmut phuhmat ynda haba, ki iohi ba ki khynnah jongki ki ia shongsuk shongsain lang baroh khlem jingiashrut.
Kida, sngewtynnad eh ia ka mynsiem rap ia ki, ba kyllut bad 'kiwei, kiwei de.

Don napdeng --- Page 9 --- LYNNONG 2 Kane Kka skul bad ingshong jong kine ki Khynnah ne ka jaka da ki khyndiat ngut ki briew'ba don ka mynsiem latrellang ban kyntiew la k! jaitbynriew bad ban arap la kiba shem lanot.Kum kine ki.jaitbriew kham niar ban shem, tang khyndiat ngut eh kiba kloi kaba pynlong ban ple kum' Kane ka fing na ka.ynta kito ki khynnah kiba anha ki dkhot met.
Bad'ka long shisha kum ka shlem jongka jingsuk iaki, naba ki ioh ymtang ka jaka rieh hynrei sa bat ka Jingnang jing- stad de.
Ki ju pynlong skul naduh ka por 10 baje mynstep haduh 3 baje janmietDon katto katne ngut ruh ki khynnah shynrang,ba shu wan na la ling, naba, k1 shong ki sah bad laka kmie ki kpa.
Hynrei kiba bun hi der kiba sah syndon hangta, kata tang k1 khyllung bad ki khynnah kynthel.
Ki khynnah ruh ki sngewnguh shibun ia ki nohgri kur ki kha jongki. Kine ki khynnah ba shong ba sah ha "Shlem Jing- suk" ki long kiba donbok shisha, nalor ka jaka sah sumar iaki.
Ladii donkam bin shn3 ne puid iaki ki ju rahnoh sha ki hospital jongki ban sumar kham bniah.
bar shnong hi ruh.

Kane ka skul ba pynlong hangne ha Shlem Jingsuk ban thoh da ka kadiang., Kiba shu shong ,pat ka, ki shuki Kali, k kham suk ban thoh , naba ki ioh ban shan ha ki miej ba lah shna Han pyndait bad Ka shuki.

--- Page 10 --- Kiba kyllut patde kam da don jingktah than eh, nabaiakila ai da ki jingdengskhor banduplohsngew bha. ,Kaba kham jynjar na baroh kadei ia kito kiba matlab, wat la katta ruh la shna kyrpang,ia ki rukom pule jongki, haka ba kin lah ban sngewthuh da kaba.
Shu tba tang da ki kti.
Napdeng kiba anna baroh, don tang, san ngut kiba matlah kiba dap da ka jingkmen bad jing kyrmen ba ha khwei ka sngi kin sa lah ban poit bad johi lem kum kr paralok jong ki.
Ka Banri ka la ong "Ah, ngi te ngi sniewbok kein ba ngim lah ban iohi, tangbayn leh.

kumno mo, haba. la, kha, sniewbok".'"Kein el ynnat khuslai ch,'ngi dei ban kmen, katba ai, u kyniad,, ym tang mangi badon ki, jingduna, kiwei pat kiba iasah lang hangne ruh kiba pli ki long hi ma ngi' la jubab sngew- lem ka Lidaka.

Kawei pat kakhynnahBhutia bakyrtengNokdi kala pynban ktien, "Ma nga ruh mynshwa la Sngewsih shibun, Iam kein, barabor, monta pat la, myllen, manga porkhat kiwei ruh baplt la dkoh, la kyllut u Blel la al ka bhah ma ng, au' lah ban leh".
Kaba det Nokdi, haba u Blel u, la , al ha_ngi Laka bhah, ng!
hab ban shu hun, Jar la ka Bhah ka bhah'' la pynkut ka.
Lidaka. LYNNONG--3 Dang 5 baje mynstep kine ki khynnah baroh ki lah dep dihsha pat ki ju pynlong jingdwal, bad nangta pat ki'sa sdang pule kot.
'Kiba pli' kiba matlah pat ki shu hap shongkai shwa, namar ba ki don ki tiar pule jong ki tang ha ka skul.
Kumta ka jingim jong ki ka, suk kynjai bad la k?
paralok bad ki nongsumar.
Wat laki long ki bymbiang.
